name: trade-os-windows
description: Connect Claude Desktop Chat to your explicitly authorized Trade OS workspace through the verified Windows companion.

companion_folder.title: Installed Trade OS companion folder
companion_folder.description: Choose the companion-* folder containing TradeOS.exe and TradeOSMcp.exe from the exact companion preview downloaded alongside this extension.

setup_file.title: Claude Desktop app setup file
setup_file.description: Choose the tradeos-claude_desktop-*.json downloaded from Trade OS. Import and authorize it in the companion first. Do not select bundle-manifest.json or a Claude Code/Codex setup.
